# OSLP - Department of Education Queensland

> > Secure login portal for Queensland Department of Education staff and students to access educational resources and services.

OSLP (Online Services Login Portal) serves as the authentication gateway for the Queensland Department of Education, providing secure access to digital learning platforms and administrative tools for educators and students across Queensland schools.

## Key Topics

- Department of Education Queensland
- Queensland education system
- Staff authentication
- Student portal access
- Education portal login
- User access management
- Criminal Code (Qld) compliance
- Terms of use
- Secure authentication
- Educational resources gateway

## Portal Access

- [Sign In - Department of Education Queensland](http://oslp.eq.edu.au/): Main login portal for Queensland Department of Education staff and students to access educational resources and services
